title: POV: you're dating a Libra. Hosting.
old_caption: A Libra can host a whole party and still check on you across the room. Then they quietly save you the best seat.

title: POV: you're dating a Scorpio. The gift.
old_caption: Mention something to a Scorpio once in March and it shows up wrapped in December. Don't call it sweet. It's nothing, apparently.

title: POV: you're dating a Sagittarius. 10 PM.
old_caption: Your Sagittarius turns up at 10 PM with a sled. The best part ends up being the quiet bit, lying in the snow under the stars.

title: POV: you're dating a Capricorn. The card.
old_caption: A Capricorn gives you the most practical gift ever made. The card that came with it took six drafts.

title: POV: you're dating an Aquarius. New Year's.
old_caption: An Aquarius celebrates midnight every hour from 7 PM. By your actual midnight they're asleep on your shoulder.

title: POV: you're dating a Pisces. The gift.
old_caption: A Pisces cries wrapping your gift and cries handing it over. Then you open it, and now you're both crying.

title: Pisces cries about a note in their coat
old_caption: Found a note in your coat that just says "thought of you today"? Pisces is on tissue five. Small words on paper carry big love.

title: Pisces cries about the lights coming on
old_caption: When the whole street lights up one house at a time and you are suddenly very emotional. Let the little beautiful things land.

title: Pisces cries about a dog in a sweater
old_caption: A dog in a striped sweater. With a pocket. Pisces did not stand a chance. Delight is allowed to be this big.

title: Pisces cries about “take your time”
old_caption: Typing, deleting, typing again, and they just say "no rush. take your time." Patience is a love language too.
